name: MsoOrgChartLayoutType
description: Indicates how to format the child nodes in an organization chart.

constants.name: msoOrgChartLayoutMixed
constants.description: Return value for a parent node that has children formatted using more than one MsoOrgChartLayoutType.

constants.name: msoOrgChartLayoutStandard
constants.description: Places child nodes horizontally below the parent node.

constants.name: msoOrgChartLayoutBothHanging
constants.description: Places child nodes vertically below the parent node on both the left and the right side.

constants.name: msoOrgChartLayoutLeftHanging
constants.description: Places child nodes vertically below the parent node on the left side.

constants.name: msoOrgChartLayoutRightHanging
constants.description: Places child nodes vertically below the parent node on the right side.
